notes.title: French has been added!
notes.notes: French language has been added to the game.

notes.title: 2021.09.13 Revision notice
notes.notes:
Fixed the awkward wording in the English translation.

Changed the color of puzzle hints for red-green colorblindness.

notes.title: August 19th bug and fix notice.
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the character's portrait was not visible depending on the resolution.

notes.title: August 18th bug and fix notice.
notes.notes:
Fixed movement when reading phone logs.

Fixed an issue where the used card key was regenerated.

Fixed Chapter 2 'Holy Water of Death' recipe not disappearing.

Fixed where character jamming occurs.

notes.title: August 17th 2nd bug and fixes.
notes.notes: Fixed the difference between the document content in the Documents tab and the actual document content.

notes.title: August 17th bug and fix notice.
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the recipe didn't match when using the Chapter 2 Combiner.

notes.title: August 16th 2nd bug and fix notice.
notes.notes: Fixed a section where the Chapter 2 animation did not play.

notes.title: August 16th bug fix, fix notice.
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where materials would disappear if you put materials in the combiner and save.

Volume control at a few points where the sound was loud.

Fixed a bug where Fuse 3 could be obtained without limit.

notes.title: August 15th bug and fix notice.
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where when using a combiner, talking to a researcher in succession would cause the player to stop.

notes.title: 2021.08.13 2nd bug and fix notice.
notes.notes:
Added language change option.

Added hints to Chapter 2 Maze.

Changed the map of Chapter 2 Operating Room 2.

Chapter 2 The map with the eyeball monster has been modified and a save point has been added.

Fixed Chapter 3 chase.

notes.title: 2021.08.13 Bug and fix notice.
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where Japanese was mixed in Chinese translation.

Slightly slowed down the recognition reaction speed of petrified monsters with a Chapter 2 archetype recognition range.

Fixed a bug in Chapter 2 where other items could be combined even if they were combined.

Fixed the recognition range of the Chapter 2 maze monster.

notes.title: Savior of the Abyss released!!!!!
notes.notes:
Savior of the Abyss has released!! 
Thank you to everyone who has been waiting for the game. 
If you have any comments about the game, please feel free to contact us at thdwhd0812@gmail.com
(You can also use your contact information.) 
Thank you!

notes.title: Announcement of game release date confirmed.
notes.notes:
Hello.
It has passed Steam review and has been confirmed for release on August 12th at 6am.
Thank you for waiting and I hope you enjoy the game.
Thank you!

notes.title: Notice of Postponing Game Release Date.
notes.notes:
Hello.
First of all, we apologize for the continued delay in the release.
We don't have experience with Steam releases, so it's vaguely quick to review Steam.
I thought it would and set a release date.
However, it continues to be delayed more than expected, and as a result, the release continues to be delayed.
situation.
It is my fault for not preparing properly and announcing the release date.
It is currently undergoing Steam review.
It's hard to say exactly when it will be released, but as soon as the review is over.
We'll release it as soon as possible, either within this week or so.
Thank you for waiting.

notes.title: Notice of game release date.
notes.notes:
Hello.
There is currently a delay in release due to some issues with Steam review.
The game is expected to be released on August 6th in North America at the earliest, or August 9th at the latest.
We apologize to those who have been waiting.
Thank you

notes.title: The Savior of The Abyss trial is over.
notes.notes:
Hello.
The release date is not far away.
That's why we want to remove the trial version from Steam.
Thank you so much for playing so far!
